summary: Source-only audit confirms reusable gateway/sink/PCR/export interfaces and existing E4413 saved-byte consumer. Root-selected smallest seam: extract its saved-byte admission/table projection into an explicit-path inspector. No producer, core, loader, ranking copy or second executor is needed. No implementation or runtime proof occurred here.

interfaces.artifact: candidateSet id=lab14.assignment.ranking.alternatives; UTF-8 JSON {schema:'lab14-ranked-alternatives@1',groups:[{badgeId,rows:[complete ScoredPairEvidence]}]}; no dims. Preserve group/row/path order, raw, factors, score and rank; do not rerank.
interfaces.gateway_sink: Existing extractor -> ExecSink.putArtifact(kind,id,bytes,dims?) -> ArtifactRef{id,kind,sha256,uri,dims?} in Receipt.artifacts. MemorySink blobs use id keys. Null-sink empty hashes cannot support admission. URI is sink-defined, not a loader instruction.
interfaces.pcr_export: PCR hashes artifact id/kind/sha256/dims-or-null, not URI/direct bytes; it does not read saved files. Fixture records ref/bytesBase64/json after real sink hash check. Capture writes exact decoded bytes as artifact-<record-index>-<artifact-index>.json.
interfaces.existing_consumer: E4413 lines79-98 reads saved bytes, matches bytesBase64/SHA, kind/id, full fixture rows and receipt ref, then forms table rows. It is fixture-specific with old hardcoded scratch roots. Extract only the data seam with explicit paths, no producer harness or general loader.

limits: Hash/ref matches establish custody against an independently pinned expectation, not upstream completeness or selected ownership. Source/dist read-only inspection only; no imports/tests/producers/CV/images/44queries, E2021/old160grid, other-owner adoption, Git or native writes. Root owns native release.
